role: Longitudinal memory, lifecycle, provenance, and reuse validation. Same constraint as MSC: not forced into the TSR framework without an appropriate workload/task layer. Used to validate lifecycle transitions, derivation chains, and provenance completeness over long-running conversational histories. (Quoted/paraphrased from phase3/specification/DATASET_CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md section 2.4.)

registry_reference.record_count_reference: data/metadata/phase2_freeze_manifest.json: memory_foundation.record_counts.conversation_chronicles = 822762 (matches the actual line count of data/processed/conversation_chronicles/memory_records.jsonl, verified in this stage).

processed_files.note: File exists on disk (verified via ls -la) and is exactly 0 bytes -- an empty placeholder, not a missing file.

inspection_method.description: Read-only inspection performed in Phase 3.2-G: first 2 lines of memory_records.jsonl read in full for field-shape confirmation; a deterministic 500-line prefix sample of memory_records.jsonl checked programmatically for memory_id uniqueness; task_records.jsonl confirmed to exist as a 0-byte file via `ls -la`; the full memory_records.jsonl file (all 822762 lines) was grep-searched for the literal field names parent_ids/equivalent_to/conflicts_with/superseded_by, with zero matches; preprocessing/datasets/conversation_chronicles.py was read to corroborate the absence of task/gold-answer construction logic (grep for evidence_memory_ids/task_id/gold across preprocessing/datasets/ matched only locomo.py and longmemeval.py).

stable_id.reason: Sampled records carry a `memory_id` field (24-hex-char identifier), same convention as the other three datasets.

unique_id.reason: 500/500 sampled memory_id values were unique in the prefix sample.

content_available.reason: Sampled records have non-empty `content` strings (e.g. "Hey there, Neighbors B! How's your day going so far?").

timestamped.reason: Sampled records carry `source_timestamp: null` and `timestamp_type: "relative"`; the only temporal information is a free-text `relative_time_interval_before_session` field in `metadata` (e.g. 'Start'). Matches data/metadata/dataset_manifest.json's known_limitations note ('no absolute timestamps, only free-text relative time_interval descriptions').

typed_foundation_or_derived.reason: No explicit type tag exists; per phase3/schemas/memory_schema.md, Phase 1/2 UMR-sourced records are foundation memories by construction, but no field asserts this explicitly.

explicit_parent_ids_present.reason: Whole-file grep of all 822762 lines for 'parent_ids' returned zero matches.

explicit_task_records.reason: data/processed/conversation_chronicles/task_records.jsonl is a 0-byte file on disk (confirmed via `ls -la`). Positively confirms 'no native task layer' per DATASET_CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md.

separate_from_memory.reason: No workload layer exists at all, so 'separate from memory' does not apply -- the antecedent is false.

query_field.reason: No query/question field exists anywhere; corroborated by preprocessing/datasets/conversation_chronicles.py containing no task-construction logic.

gold_answer_field.reason: No answer field exists anywhere for Conversation Chronicles.

task_id_field.reason: No task_id field exists anywhere for Conversation Chronicles.

session_or_conversation_id.reason: Memory-level session_id/conversation_id fields exist and are populated -- a memory-layer capability independent of the (absent) task layer, and exactly the longitudinal/repeated-interaction structure DATASET_CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md calls this dataset's 'primary use case.'

evidence_availability.reason: No task/workload layer exists (task_records.jsonl is 0 bytes), so no gold-evidence-ID field exists anywhere. This is the single most important field for the Strict-TSR audit: Conversation Chronicles positively lacks it.

answer_availability.reason: No gold-answer field exists anywhere, for the same reason as evidence_availability.

provenance_availability.reason: Sampled memory records carry a full `provenance` object (conversation_id, session_id, source_dataset, source_file, source_record_id, turn_id, extraction_pipeline_version) -- exactly the substrate DATASET_CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md calls this dataset's 'primary use case' for provenance validation. This is the foundation-memory source pointer, not a derived-memory parent-edge structure.

lineage_availability.reason: No parent_ids edges exist anywhere in the file (whole-file grep, 0 matches). IMPORTANT DISCREPANCY NOTE (same as noted for MSC): DATASET_CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md lists 'Lifecycle suitability: Primary use case' for Conversation Chronicles, which this profile does not contradict -- but at the raw current-file level, this dataset's lineage-graph richness (zero explicit parent edges) is identical to all three other datasets. The matrix's 'primary use case' framing is about this dataset's strong longitudinal/repeated-interaction structure (session_summary and relationship metadata across many sessions per episode) being well-suited for lifecycle/provenance/reuse machinery once a memory-creation policy exists -- not a claim that parent_ids/lineage data already exists in the current substrate.

equivalence_availability.reason: Whole-file grep of all 822762 lines for 'equivalent_to' returned zero matches.

temporal_information.reason: source_timestamp is null and timestamp_type is 'relative' in sampled records; the only temporal signal is a free-text metadata.relative_time_interval_before_session field (e.g. 'Start') plus session/event ordering -- not a machine-comparable absolute or duration timestamp. Matches data/metadata/dataset_manifest.json's known_limitations note.

RECALL_AT_K.reason: No task layer and no gold evidence IDs exist -- Recall@K requires a gold_id, which does not exist here.

MRR.reason: Same absence of gold evidence IDs as RECALL_AT_K.

STRICT_TSR.reason: strict_tsr requires a literal gold evidence memory ID; none exists for Conversation Chronicles (task_records.jsonl is 0 bytes). Per the 3.2-G task brief, UNAVAILABLE rather than SUPPORTED_WITH_ADAPTER because no partial task layer was found.

SELECTION_COUNT.reason: selection_count needs only a selected_memory_ids sequence, dataset-agnostic -- usable for lifecycle/reuse characterization without a task layer.

SELECTION_CAPACITY_DIAGNOSTICS.reason: Requires a gold_id, which does not exist for this dataset.

EVIDENCE_PRECISION.reason: Requires evidence_memory_ids (gold), which do not exist.

EVIDENCE_RECALL.reason: Same absence of gold evidence IDs.

EVIDENCE_COVERAGE.reason: Same absence of gold evidence IDs.

IRRELEVANT_MEMORY_RATE.reason: Requires a gold-evidence-id basis; none exists.

REDUNDANCY.reason: Identity-duplicate-only redundancy needs only a selected-memory-id sequence -- dataset-agnostic, usable for reuse/lifecycle characterization.

EQUIVALENCE_DIAGNOSTICS.reason: No explicit equivalent_to edges exist anywhere (whole-file grep, 0 matches); would become SUPPORTED_WITH_ADAPTER only if a future memory-creation policy declares such edges over this dataset's session_summary/relationship structure -- not the case today.

PROVENANCE_VALIDATION.reason: Every sampled record carries a full `provenance` object; validate_provenance/provenance_completeness_report operate on this directly, independent of any task layer -- exactly the 'primary use case' DATASET_CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md names.

LINEAGE_DIAGNOSTICS.reason: No parent_ids edges exist anywhere in the current substrate (whole-file grep, 0 matches); nothing for ancestors/descendants/lineage_depth/detect_cycles to operate on today.

AGENT_ANSWER_CORRECTNESS.reason: No gold answer exists (no task layer); undefined without an expected_answer.

AGENT_SUCCESS.reason: Thin wrapper over answer correctness; same absence.

MEMORY_CONTRIBUTION.reason: Requires an expected_answer on both sides of a paired comparison, which does not exist.

OBSERVED_GOLD_EVIDENCE_CEILING.reason: Requires GOLD_EVIDENCE-condition results plus expected answers, neither of which exist.

RETRIEVAL_UTILIZATION.reason: Mechanically needs only selected_memory_ids/used_memory_ids, not gold data -- but constructing a legitimate execution result absent any real task to execute would be synthetic, hence PROVISIONAL rather than SUPPORTED (same reasoning as MSC's profile).

FAILURE_STAGE_CLASSIFICATION.reason: Requires gold_evidence_ids and an expected_answer, neither of which exist.

NO_MEMORY.reason: NO_MEMORY is defined relative to a task ('task-only, no memory content'); with no task layer at all, there is no task to present under this condition, so it is UNDEFINED rather than SUPPORTED or UNAVAILABLE.

GOLD_EVIDENCE.reason: Requires gold evidence content selected via evidence_memory_ids, which does not exist.

RETRIEVED_MEMORY.reason: RETRIEVED_MEMORY is Condition C, defined as memory retrieved+selected FOR A TASK; with no task layer, 'retrieval for this task' is undefined, not merely unbuilt.

SELECTED_MEMORY_AVAILABLE.reason: This PROVISIONAL condition does not require the full RETRIEVED_MEMORY task-pipeline semantics -- it only asserts 'some selected memory content is present,' which memory_records.jsonl content can populate once some selection mechanism exists.

DERIVED_MEMORY_AVAILABLE.reason: No derived memories exist in the current substrate (no parent_ids anywhere).

CONFLICTING_MEMORY_AVAILABLE.reason: No conflicts_with edges exist anywhere in the file (whole-file grep, 0 matches).

adapter_requirements: Per PHASE3_CLEAN_AGENT_FOUNDATION_SPEC.md section 4 and DATASET_CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md section 4, whether/how a workload/task layer is ever added for Conversation Chronicles is explicitly OUT OF SCOPE for Phase 3.1/3.2 and deferred to a future capability-gap analysis -- this profile does not propose or build one.

A longitudinal lifecycle/provenance/reuse test harness operating directly on memory_records.jsonl's session_id/conversation_id/provenance/session_summary structure without assuming a task/gold layer -- the legitimate current use case per the matrix.

If a future memory-creation policy begins producing derived memories with explicit parent_ids over this dataset's session_summary/relationship structure, LINEAGE_DIAGNOSTICS and EQUIVALENCE_DIAGNOSTICS would need re-evaluation against the resulting data -- not assumed available now.
limitations: task_records.jsonl is confirmed a 0-byte file, not merely 'not sampled' -- treated as a positive NOT_PROVIDED_BY_SOURCE finding, not UNKNOWN.

Conversation Chronicles has no absolute or numerically-comparable relative timestamps, only free-text relative_time_interval_before_session descriptions (e.g. 'Start') -- per data/metadata/dataset_manifest.json's own known_limitations field, corroborated directly from the processed file.

data/metadata/dataset_manifest.json also notes 'Speaker role label casing/pluralization is inconsistent for the same underlying role' -- this profile does not attempt to normalize or verify that inconsistency; it is inherited, read-only, from the frozen Phase 1/2 substrate.
Inspection was sample-based (500/822762 memory records for uniqueness) except for the relationship-field-name greps and the task_records.jsonl file-size check, which covered the whole file/dataset.

evidence_notes.claim: memory_id is present, stable-looking, and unique in a 500-record sample.
task_records.jsonl is a 0-byte file, positively confirming no native task layer.
source_timestamp is null and timestamp_type is 'relative' in sampled records; only a free-text relative_time_interval_before_session metadata field exists.
No memory record anywhere in the file declares parent_ids, equivalent_to, conflicts_with, or superseded_by.
